title: Test every Broken branch of a parser with input that reaches it
rule: For each code path that turns malformed font data into Health::Broken (header error, table out of bounds, table present but malformed, sub-structure malformed), add a test with a crafted or mutated fixture that reaches that exact branch and asserts Broken with a reason naming the table. Sweeps that only check 'no panic' (`let _ = parse(...)`) do not count as coverage of the Broken behavior.
rationale: E2.2 (#45): only the 'table cut off' branch was tested; replacing the malformed-table arm with `table.ok()` left all 19 parser tests green, so in-bounds table damage could silently regress to Health::Ok.
